title: Overseer overhaul — Option C (hybrid): retire the respawning watcher pod for orchestrator-side deterministic evaluation + a bounded corrective vocabulary, with a normal on-demand OVERSEER agent only for adversarial adjudication
summary: Architecture for the full §1–§6 overseer overhaul under the two resolved refine HITLs: cq-1 = Option C (hybrid) and cq-2 = all-in-one. The spine is a structural reshape: the standing, ~90s-respawned overseer watcher pod and its baked-in `overseer_monitor.py` bootstrap (the direct cause of the §1 self-injection loop) are RETIRED. Overseership becomes (a) deterministic, lifecycle-owner-aware evaluation over the event stream running IN-PROCESS on the orchestrator (extending the existing `health_checks/` Tier-1 package), (b) a small BOUNDED corrective vocabulary (open-operator-HITL, nudge, cohort-respawn) executed control-plane-side by the orchestrator — which already owns contract writes, dissolving the §4 403 problem entirely, and (c) a NORMAL on-demand agent spawned via `spawn_agent_job(agent_role=OVERSEER, …)` at Opus tier through `resolve_agent_model`, invoked ONLY to adjudicate ambiguous/adversarial escalations — no standing pod, no `EGG_OVERSEER_*` flags, no trust-and-run script. Deliverable #1 is a tested known-normal/known-bad calibration corpus that every detector (existing and new) is calibrated against. The §5 coverage-gap survey is delivered in full (cq-2 all-in-one). §6 cleanup is net-negative in lines (the retired pod + bootstrap + respawn machinery is a large deletion). LIVE EVIDENCE captured this very plan phase: the Sonnet (`claude-sonnet-4-6`) overseer received its baked-in bootstrap, classified it as 'authority laundering / arbitrary-code-to-production-action', refused, exited 0, and was respawned (attempt 1/3) — the §1 loop reproducing in real time.

problem_statement.description: The overseer is simultaneously too loud (a stream of false alarms operators learn to ignore) and useless at the moment of need (real deadlocks surface as a generic `stuck-phase-transition` or nothing). Two structural facts settle the shape: (1) the deterministic Tier-1 detectors ALREADY run orchestrator-side in `orchestrator/health_checks/tier1/` — the agent pod is not where most detection happens; (2) #3064 (merged) moved to orchestrator-owned on-demand spawning, so there is no long-lived phase cohort for a watcher pod to shadow, and a pod respawned every ~90s exit-0 (including multi-hour HITL parks with zero agents running) is pure cost bleed. The resolved cq-1 selects Option C: keep deterministic detection + a bounded corrective vocabulary orchestrator-side; spawn a NORMAL agent only for adversarial adjudication. This kills the respawn churn, the bootstrap self-injection loop, and the lifecycle-owner-blind stall detector STRUCTURALLY, not by tuning a threshold.
goals: AC-1 (§1, folds #2813): the overseer decision tier no longer defaults to Sonnet; the adjudicator model is resolved through `resolve_agent_model` with explicit tiering (Haiku classify / Sonnet routine / Opus adversarial). `overseer_decision_maker_model` (models.py:726) is deprecated; `kubernetes_spawner.py:2919` stops calling `classify_model(decision_model)`.

AC-2 (§1.5): no `spawn_overseer_job`, no `EGG_OVERSEER_MODE`/`EGG_OVERSEER_POLL_INTERVAL`/`EGG_OVERSEER_DECISION_MODEL` flags, no baked-in `sandbox/overseer_monitor.py` trust-and-run bootstrap. Any surviving agent runs through `spawn_agent_job(agent_role=OVERSEER)` + the standard entrypoint/image; whatever monitoring it needs arrives via tools/MCP/prompt.

AC-3 (§2, calibration — DELIVERABLE #1): a tested known-normal/known-bad corpus (self-injection loop, alert-reflection, #3230 false stall, #2242 heartbeat-stall, #2222/#2224 branch-divergence, #2948 eviction-misread) that detection is calibrated against; the stall detector made lifecycle-owner-aware; the alert-reflection injection path stops surfacing overseer agent-bus broadcasts as operator HITL directives; #2059/#2132 thrashing/spinning/improper-tool-use definitions added.

AC-4 (§3, lifecycle): respawn churn eliminated — no overseer during HITL parks with zero agents running; `_check_and_respawn_overseer` (routes/pipelines.py:685-848) removed/folded; escalation-history + generation-token reset hygiene on restart/recycle.

AC-5 (§4, authority — made structural): a control-plane-side authorized path to open operator HITLs + a bounded corrective vocabulary (nudge, cohort respawn). Under Option C the orchestrator executes these directly (it already owns contract writes), so the 403 dissolves; the agent only ADVISES.

AC-6 (§5, coverage gaps — FULL survey per cq-2 all-in-one): verified + extended detector coverage across orchestrator-runtime, worktree/branch, container/k8s, gateway, BRC/thrashing, HITL/decision-queue, cost/budget, overseer self-health, external-state, and LLM-substrate layers — each lifecycle-owner-aware and corpus-tested; the `OverseerSelfMonitor` alert-emission nuance resolved.
AC-7 (§6, cleanup): net-negative line count; collapse per-class fail-soft scaffolding; de-duplicate advisor-escalation plumbing; harden two-tier `file_issue` dedup.

design.shape_decision: Option C (hybrid), cq-1 resolved. The reshape has three planes: (1) DETECTION plane — deterministic, lifecycle-owner-aware evaluators run in-process on the orchestrator event loop, extending health_checks/. (2) AUTHORITY/CORRECTIVE plane — a small bounded vocabulary {open_operator_hitl, nudge_agent, respawn_cohort} executed by the orchestrator control plane (which already owns contract writes and k8s spawns). (3) ADJUDICATION plane — a NORMAL on-demand OVERSEER agent (spawn_agent_job, Opus via resolve_agent_model), invoked ONLY when a deterministic detector escalates an ambiguous/adversarial case; it returns a structured verdict + recommended corrective action, and the orchestrator (plane 2) executes it. The agent never acts directly — dissolving §4.
design.why_option_C_over_B: B (full retirement of the agent) is the larger deletion but loses the ability to adjudicate genuinely-ambiguous adversarial cases with an LLM. C keeps that capability but removes everything that caused the pathologies: the STANDING pod (cost bleed), the RESPAWN loop (churn), the BAKED-IN bootstrap (self-injection root cause), and the LIFECYCLE-BLIND stall detection. The agent that remains is normal, on-demand, and stateless per invocation — satisfying §1.5's 'if it remains an agent, it is a normal agent — no parallel plumbing'.
design.detection_plane: Detectors are pure functions over an EventStreamSnapshot (running-agent set WITH lifecycle-owner annotation per #3230, BRC consensus matrix, phase/decision state, container transitions, gateway error counters, cost counters). Each detector returns Optional[Finding{class, severity, evidence, recommended_action, requires_adjudication: bool}]. 'Known-normal' inputs MUST yield None; 'known-bad' inputs MUST yield the expected Finding — this is the calibration-corpus contract (AC-3). Lifecycle-owner-awareness is the structural fix for the #3230 false stall: a producer drafting under orchestrator-owned spawning is NOT 'a phase with 0 running agents'.
design.authority_plane: A new orchestrator-side CorrectiveExecutor with a CLOSED vocabulary. open_operator_hitl → writes a contract decision via the same internal path register_open_question uses, but as the orchestrator identity (no gateway 403). nudge_agent → directed wake (reuses _send_brc_confirmation_nudge plumbing). respawn_cohort → bounded restart via the GENERAL agent-restart machinery (AC-4 fold target), NOT overseer-specific. Every corrective action is rate-limited, audit-logged, and keyed so it cannot fire during HITL parks with zero agents.
design.adjudication_plane: When requires_adjudication is set, the orchestrator spawns spawn_agent_job(agent_role=OVERSEER, model=resolve_agent_model(OVERSEER, tier=adversarial)) with a prompt carrying the Finding + evidence + the EventStreamSnapshot via MCP/tools (NOT a baked-in script). The agent returns a structured verdict {confirmed: bool, recommended_action: <vocabulary>, rationale}. Orchestrator executes via the authority plane. The agent is one-shot; no respawn supervision, no standing pod, no EGG_OVERSEER_* env.
design.alert_reflection_fix: midturn_messages._INJECT_FROM_ROLES must distinguish an OVERSEER agent-bus broadcast / orchestrator informational alert from a genuine operator HITL directive. Design: gate injection on message_type/intent (operator-directive vs informational/alert), not solely on from_role. Overseer/orchestrator informational alerts (e.g. overseer_restart [info]) MUST NOT render as 'BINDING course corrections'. Retain the #3123 brc-confirmation-timeout nudge surfacing (that IS a directed course correction) — the discriminator is intent, not role.
design.branch_divergence_fix: Replace the _BRANCH_DIVERGENCE_PR_RE subject-pattern test with the correct semantic test: a commit is merged-main contamination iff it is an ancestor of origin/main OR its patch-id matches a commit already on origin/main. Subject `(#NNNN)` matching is a false-positive generator (#2222/#2224).
design.calibration_corpus: A fixtures package of recorded/synthesized EventStreamSnapshots labelled known-normal | known-bad{class}. Covers: self-injection loop, alert-reflection, #3230 false stall (producer drafting under orchestrator-owned spawn), #2242 heartbeat-stall (agent making tool calls every 2-3s), #2222/#2224 branch-divergence (ancestor/patch-id vs subject regex), #2948 transient kubelet eviction (must NOT cascade to producer-permanent-death FAILED). Each detector ships with a calibration test asserting its verdict over the relevant corpus rows. This is the AC-3 deliverable-#1 contract and the regression harness all later detectors plug into.
design.self_health_resolution: Resolve the OverseerSelfMonitor nuance: check_health() must EMIT through the alert path (not only log) so classifier/advisor failure-rate anomalies are visible. Under Option C 'self-health' becomes detection-plane self-checks on the in-process evaluators + the adjudicator spawn success-rate.
design.coverage_gap_survey: cq-2 all-in-one — deliver the full §5 survey as corpus-tested, lifecycle-owner-aware deterministic detectors in health_checks/, each escalating to adjudication only when ambiguous: orchestrator-runtime (_run_pipeline thread liveness #2234/#3233, auto-advance wedge → Tier-1 #2219, approved-decision-orphaned, duration drift, agent-restart propagation deadline, restarted-decision replay); worktree/branch (corrected ancestor/patch-id git-history sanity, corruption/lock anomalies, disk/inode pressure); container/k8s (funnel pod transitions through overseer #2210, repeated same-role restarts, OOMKilled/evicted #2948); gateway (error-rate spikes, repeated identical denials, token-expiry); BRC/thrashing (reviewer/producer thrash, late CONFIRMED then re-NACK, cap unbounded incomplete-consensus deferral, #2059/#2132 spinning/improper-tool-use); HITL/decision-queue; cost/budget (token-cost anomaly, max_llm_cost_per_hour, fix incomplete cost tracking in self_monitor.py); overseer self-health (classifier/advisor failure-rate wired to alert path); external-state (pr_external_mutation drift, pushed-but-PR-not-updated); LLM-substrate (LiteLLM-proxy reachability #2769, effective-model drift, sustained Anthropic 5xx).

acceptance_criteria.text: Overseer decision/adjudication model resolved via resolve_agent_model with explicit tiering; default no longer Sonnet; overseer_decision_maker_model deprecated; kubernetes_spawner no longer routes the overseer model through classify_model(decision_model). Folds #2813.

spawn_overseer_job removed/folded into spawn_agent_job(agent_role=OVERSEER); EGG_OVERSEER_MODE/POLL_INTERVAL/DECISION_MODEL removed; baked-in overseer_monitor.py trust-and-run bootstrap removed; any surviving agent uses the standard image/entrypoint and receives context via MCP/tools/prompt.

A tested known-normal/known-bad calibration corpus exists; the stall detector is lifecycle-owner-aware (#3230); branch-divergence uses ancestor/patch-id not subject regex (#2222/#2224); the alert-reflection path no longer surfaces overseer/orchestrator informational alerts as operator HITL directives; #2059/#2132 thrashing/spinning/improper-tool-use definitions added. Each detector has a calibration test.

Respawn churn eliminated — no overseer during HITL parks with zero agents running; _check_and_respawn_overseer removed/folded into the general agent-restart machinery; escalation-history + generation-token reset on restart/recycle.

A structural, authorized control-plane path opens operator HITLs and executes a bounded corrective vocabulary (nudge, cohort respawn); the on-demand agent only advises. The roles.py:can_modify claim is documented as stale; the real enforcement point (gateway/agent_restrictions.py + contract RBAC) is dissolved by control-plane execution.
Full §5 coverage-gap survey delivered as corpus-tested, lifecycle-owner-aware detectors across all ten layers; OverseerSelfMonitor check_health() emits through the alert path.

Net-negative line count overall; per-class fail-soft scaffolding collapsed; advisor-escalation plumbing de-duplicated; two-tier file_issue dedup hardened; issue_filer.py NOT deleted on the stale #1962 premise.

risks_for_risk_analyst: Retiring the standing pod removes a (noisy but present) watcher during the cutover window — the orchestrator-side evaluator must be live and corpus-validated BEFORE the pod/respawn machinery is deleted (slice ordering enforces this: detection plane lands before removal).

midturn_messages._INJECT_FROM_ROLES is shared egg_agent code consumed by ALL agents — the intent-discriminator change must not silently drop the #3123 brc-confirmation-timeout nudge (golden-file/regression test required).
Branch-divergence ancestor/patch-id test runs git plumbing in the hot phase-poll path — cost/latency must be bounded (cache patch-ids; cap the scan window).

Coverage-gap breadth (cq-2 all-in-one) is the largest scope-runaway surface — each detector is gated behind the calibration-corpus contract so 'shipped' means 'corpus-tested', preventing a flood of new false-positive sources.

Authority plane executes real corrective actions (HITL open, respawn) — must be rate-limited, audit-logged, and idempotent; a buggy corrective is worse than a false alert. Recommend shadow-first telemetry before any auto-escalation fires unattended.
deprecating overseer_decision_maker_model / removing EGG_OVERSEER_* may strand redeploy/config (#3233) — needs a deprecation shim + config-migration note.
